$comment: Target registry. bbox is [minLng,minLat,maxLng,maxLat]. The osm-city-2d-data workflow builds a matrix from exactly this file (jq '[.cities[] | select(.extract != null)]'), so a city absent here is never built. Generated by scripts/build-osm-cities-json.mjs from every *-city-atlas page, with the Geofabrik extract resolved via ISO2 -> slug. US cities carry a longitude-derived region plus a `fallback` list the workflow retries on an empty result. A city whose extract is not staged in R2 is omitted rather than given a bogus one.
